meta.name: Atelier Textiles
meta.description: Brand pages keyed to API brand slugs, homepage sections and banner art, plus the built-in posts and pages collections.

collections.label: Site Sections
collections.description: Copy and imagery for the storefront's art-directed bands. The entry slug is the join key and is FIXED per section — create/edit these slugs only: shop-by-type and shop-by-application (the two shop tiles), latest-collections (heading + View all link), home-manifesto (the espresso Atelier band; Subtitle is the pronunciation), home-houses (the design-houses band). A blank field falls back to the copy shipped in the site, so a section can override just its image or just its title.

fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Relative site path (e.g. /products) or a full URL.

fields.label: Copy alignment
fields.description: Where the band's copy sits. Leave empty (or left) for the designed default.

fields.label: Photo wash
fields.description: Darkness of the wash over the photograph. Softer washes let more of the image through — check the copy stays readable over it. Leave empty for the designed default.

fields.label: Hide this section
fields.description: Removes the section from the page entirely; the entry keeps its content for when it comes back.

collections.label: Page Sections
collections.description: Extra sections the office adds to a page — pick a designed section type, a placement slot, and fill the copy. Photo band is the full-bleed photograph band (no image = a solid dark band); Split feature is a photograph beside the copy. Position orders sections sharing a slot (lower first). Sections appear on the site as soon as they are published; Hide keeps one out of the page without losing it.

fields.label: Placement
fields.description: Which slot of the page the section renders in.

fields.label: Position
fields.description: Orders sections sharing a placement slot — lower renders first.

fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Relative site path (e.g. /products) or a full URL.

collections.label: Collection Banners
collections.description: Commissioned photography for a featured collection on the homepage. House and Collection are the join keys: House is the brand's web address (slug) in atelier-api, Collection is the collection's web address within that house (shown in the CRM's Houses & collections screen). Banner is the full-bleed hero frame (landscape, ~2560px); Portrait is the featured-collection band's upright frame. A banner here overrides the art shipped in the site for that collection; which collections appear at all is still the CRM's featured ranking.

collections.label: Brand Pages
collections.description: Editorial content for a brand page. The entry slug MUST equal the brand slug in atelier-api (e.g. pierre-frey) — that is the only key joining this entry to the live catalogue brand at /brands/<slug>. A slug with no matching API brand still renders; a brand with no entry falls back to its markdown page, then to the API story.

fields.label: Collection Cards
fields.description: Editorial dressing for the live catalogue collections on the brand page. Collection is the join key: it must equal the collection's web address (slug) in the CRM's Houses & collections screen. A matching card decorates that tile (image + description); the tile itself, its link and whether it shows at all come from the live catalogue — only collections that actually hold products appear.

data.title: Atelier
data.subtitle: [ at-l-yey ]
data.body: True to the French word for workshop, Atelier is a space built for creation. We've curated thousands of luxury fabrics, wall coverings, and furnishings from the world's leading design capitals. Step into our workspace and discover the inspiration to bring your bespoke interiors to life.

data.title: The World's Finest Design Houses
data.body: From the legendary textile mills of Europe to innovative global creators, we are a boutique importer and distributor of the world’s most luxurious furnishing brands.
